what: the long top edge of a 5x5 bar rounded r10, wider than both faces it rounds
method: a convex round past its faces' far edges is built on the faces continued and its removal subtracted (smlib_fillet): the section keeps the bar's 5x5 square [0,5]x[0,5] (y,z) within the round's circle, centre (10,-5), radius 10. The circle crosses z=0 at y = 10-sqrt(75) and y=5 at z = sqrt(75)-5, and contains the corner (5,0), so with u = 10-y the area is integral from 5 to sqrt(75) of (sqrt(100-u^2) - 5) du = 50 (pi/3 - pi/6) - 5 (sqrt(75) - 5) = 25 pi/3 - 5 sqrt(75) + 25 = 7.8786686; V = 80 area = 2000 pi/3 - 400 sqrt(75) + 2000 = 630.2934873
